```python
import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Sample DataFrame
data = {
    "store": ["A", "B", "A", "B", "A"],
    "revenue": [100, 200, 150, 250, 120],
    "items": [10, 20, 15, 25, 12]
}
df_native = pd.DataFrame(data)
df = nw.from_native(df_native)

# Compute per-store statistics
result = df.group_by("store").agg(
    nw.col("revenue").sum(),
    nw.col("items").mean()
).sort("store")

print(result)
```
